metadata.description:
Hello, earthling, and welcome to Your Turn!

In this interactive adventure, you decide what happens. As you listen to the
story unfold, you'll be asked to make choices using the left and right buttons
on your Yoto player. Each choice will take you—and the story—in a different
Direction.

In this story you’ll find yourself exploring a space station full of
friendly aliens—and facing one big problem! Will you be able to solve
Starbound Station’s dilemma and make it home in time for dinner? Or will you
end up lost in space?

Are you ready? It's Your Turn to decide the story.

Written by Stewart C. Baker

PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto Player or Yoto Mini and a physical Yoto Card to experience this Interactive Story as intended. While tracks will play sequentially in the app, listeners will not be able to make choices and, as a result, will not get the full experience. We recommend allowing the content to fully download before playing.
narrators: Nezar Alderazi with a cast of Tim Dann, Jessica Dennis, Liis Mikk, Mat Fraser, Rebecca Husain, Tom Alexander, Emma Clarke
